question: Should this PR require real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client proof for this media fallback fix?
rationale: The patch is source-backed and reuses the existing helper, but repository policy treats external channel delivery behavior as needing real setup proof unless a maintainer intentionally accepts the gap.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording shows image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal against a real Feishu setup.

options.title: Accept Mocked Seam Proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge based on helper reuse and regression tests while owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a short recording shows image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal against a real Feishu setup.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the shared Feishu reply fallback helper and is the strongest history signal for deciding whether mocked proof is enough here.
